column1: # Engine wave W5 (18 Oct 2026, rulings R136–R138): the regional safe default for the Balkans and their neighbours
# (`default.safe.balkans`, Generic.kt; spec §6.2 c), gated for the first time, as a stress test only: no table is
# held for any country it serves (North Macedonia, Serbia outside Sandžak, Croatia, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece,
# Romania, Cyprus, Moldova), so it is checked against the four Balkan authorities whose tables are held, each of
# which has its own entry and is never routed here: IZ BiH's Sarajevo 2026 (vaktija), BIK's 2026 Takvimi at its
# own base point (the imsak table and the Sabah column), KMSH's Tirana 2026 and IZCG's Podgorica September 2026,
# each at the point its own gate file uses. Every row is held out. What the rows show is the cost of the region's
# design (its late limits, Generic.kt, balkansLateLimits): Fajr 10 to 26 min after the dawn Bosnia, Albania and
# Montenegro print (this region's Fajr is Kosovo's Sabah, 19° + 20 min, the latest in the region) and up to 7 min
# after BIK's own Sabah, Isha 6 to 33 min after their 17° to 18° one (this region's is the 18.5° + 2 min), the end
# of eating 7 to 16 min before Bosnia's and Albania's Fajr (the 19° dawn − 2 min), and the floors (Diyanet's
# temkin, Montenegro's Maghrib + 9) plus the cushion on the rest (Dhuhr up to 9 min after, Maghrib up to 8, Asr
# up to 7, sunrise up to 6 before).
# Masked cells, each a limit of the fallback for the owner (BUILD-LOG, W5), never an exception added quietly:
# - BIK's Asr is not checked. BIK prints its Asr 2 to 11 min after the first shadow (Balkans.kt), its own
#   convention, up to 7 min after this region's floor (Diyanet's + 4 with the cushion) on 165 days of 2026 at
#   the base table's own point (154 at Prishtina on the first pass): a start before BIK's. Kosovo is never served by this region (xk.bik
#   holds the table); taking BIK's Asr as the region's floor is a §6.2 c change for the owner.
# - BIK's imsak and sunrise are not checked. Its imsak lies between 18.5° and 19.7° by month (Balkans.kt), so on
#   3 days of 2026 this region's end of eating (the 19° dawn − 2 min) comes a minute after it, and its sunrise
#   carries per-month steps deeper than Diyanet's − 7 on 5 days, a minute before this region's: late ends by a
#   minute against Kosovo's own perpetual table, the same §6.2 c question. Its Dhuhr, Maghrib and Isha are
#   checked, and the Sabah column (the Fajr shown in Kosovo) is checked as this region's Fajr.
